items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Miles had Chick Corea, Jack DeJohnette --

ctx.x: No, Jack DeJohnette. I think Wayne Shorter was with the band. It was either Wayne or George Coleman. However, we're playing at this club -- what do they call that club? Well-known jazz club in Boston. Anyway, all these musicians come over after their shows, you know, and Beaver was (inaudible) down that night.
